svg.title: MedScale application icon - light
svg.desc: The approved paired M on a monochrome square surface. Visible mark height is 40 of 128 units; outer padding exceeds half the mark height. The operating system may apply its own icon mask.
svg.metadata: MedScale Spec 095. Canonical equilateral construction: side 100, height 86.60254, offset 60, overlap removed.
